description: Replace naive calendar-day addition with business-day addition that skips weekends and is exact for any starting weekday
prompts: dates.ts's addBusinessDays(start: Date, n: number): Date just adds n calendar days in milliseconds - it counts weekends as business days. Implement it properly: n=0 returns a Date equal to start unchanged (even if start itself falls on a weekend); for n>0, step forward day by day, skipping Saturdays (getUTCDay()===6) and Sundays (getUTCDay()===0), until n business days have been counted, then return that Date. It must be exact for any starting weekday and correctly cross month/year boundaries - do not use an approximation formula like `n + 2*Math.floor(n/5)` calendar-days shortcut, it gives the wrong answer depending on which weekday `start` falls on. Treat all dates as UTC to avoid timezone drift. The file must compile under tsc --strict.
name: add_ts_business_day_date_math

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit dates.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build dates.ts
node behavior_test.js
